title: kpidash service status
description: Payload of kpidash:services:{name}:{host} — latest-value, no TTL, reader-owned staleness via ts (60 s window in kpidash). Key is always 4 segments; {host} sentinel `_` means no host. Identity is (name, host); the key is authoritative over any payload echo.

ts.description: Unix seconds (float) of last payload; drives staleness

text.description: Short status text shown on the card

host.description: Echo of the key's host segment, display only
